name: Cuspicephalus
sum: Long-headed wukongopterid-like monofenestratan from the Kimmeridge Clay of Dorset, England.
wsnote: Estimated 1.2–1.75 m from a 32.6 cm skull.
holotype: MJML 1918 — Kimmeridge Clay, Kimmeridge Bay, Dorset (found by Steve Etches, 2009).
exceptional: Most extreme skull length-to-height ratio (~5.5:1) of any pterosaur.
biology: Elongated, toothed snout with a low crest; diet not specifically studied.
author: Martill and Etches 2013

species.name: Cuspicephalus scarfi
species.author: Martill and Etches 2013
